_comment: Tool registry for the Hermes gateway. The stable contract is the shell
commands, not this file's schema: if your Hermes build expects a
different manifest shape, keep the commands and re-shape the wrapper.
Every command is safe to run from the repo root on the VM, as the
'hermes' user, and prints a machine-readable report block at the end.
NOTE: ordinary deploys come from GitHub Actions on main. The deploy tools
here are for the two cases CI cannot handle: rolling back, and redeploying
an image that is already built.

tools.name: project_status
tools.description: Read-only snapshot: current commit, dirty files, spec status board, production health, running containers, recent agent runs. Use for any question about the state of the project or of production.

tools.name: run_pipeline
tools.description: The full spec-driven loop for a change request: write or amend the spec, implement it, review it, then deploy to production. Stops by itself if the spec has open questions a human must answer. This is the default tool for 'change the app so that ...'.

args.name: request
args.description: The human's request, verbatim, in the language they used.

tools.name: write_spec
tools.description: Write or amend a specification only, without implementing it. Use when the human wants to agree on the behaviour before any code is written.

tools.name: implement_spec
tools.description: Implement a specification that already exists and is ready for code. Takes a spec id such as 0004, or a path such as specs/0004-match-lifecycle.md.

tools.name: review_changes
tools.description: Read-only review of the most recent commit against its specification and the project conventions. Returns findings; changes nothing.

args.name: spec
args.description: Optional spec id or path; inferred from the commit trailer if omitted.

tools.name: deploy
tools.description: Redeploy an image that already exists in GHCR, with no downtime (blue/green behind a graceful Caddy reload). Ordinary releases come from GitHub Actions on main — use this only to redeploy a known tag.

args.name: tag
args.description: Image tag, e.g. sha-a1b2c3d. Get it from deploy_status or from the Actions run.

tools.name: deploy_status
tools.description: Which colour is live, which image and commit it runs, the previous deploy, and the current health response. Read-only.

tools.name: rollback
tools.description: Return production to the previous image, with no downtime. CODE ONLY: the database is never rolled back, because reverting it would destroy results players entered since the deploy. Use when the site is broken and the cause is the last release.

tools.name: check_errors
tools.description: Run the error watcher once, now: health, recent log errors, disk. Sends an alert if it finds something new. Use when somebody says the site is misbehaving.

tools.name: test_alerts
tools.description: Send a test message to the alert channels, to prove they work before the party rather than during it.
